name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: A gradient area draws in under a trucking camera and lands on a tooltip. Light or dark.

props.name: data
props.doc: The series, left to right.

props.name: title
props.doc: Heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: Muted line under the heading.

props.name: seriesName
props.doc: Name shown in the tooltip row.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Index of the point the tooltip ends on.

props.name: mode
props.doc: Colour theme: light or dark.

props.name: palette
props.type: primary | monochrome | ocean | sunset | grove | vivid
props.doc: Chart palette: primary (indigo, yellow, fuchsia, mist, black), monochrome, ocean, sunset, grove or vivid.

props.name: color
props.doc: Which palette colour (--chart-1 to --chart-5, as 0 to 4) draws the series.

props.name: format.prefix
props.doc: Before the number, e.g. "$".

props.name: format.suffix
props.doc: After the number, e.g. "%" or "k".

props.name: format.decimals
props.doc: Digits after the decimal point.

props.name: format.group
props.doc: Thousands separator, a comma by default. Empty for none.

props.name: drawSeconds
props.doc: How long the line takes to draw.

props.name: holdSeconds
props.doc: How long the last frame holds on the tooltip.

props.name: markers
props.doc: A dot at every data point as the line passes it.

props.name: camera.tightZoom
props.doc: Zoom while riding the line tip.

props.name: camera.wideZoom
props.doc: Zoom of the whole chart.

props.name: camera.lead
props.doc: Screen pixels the camera leads the tip by.

props.name: camera.motionBlur
props.doc: Strength of the motion blur on the fast moves; 0 turns it off.

props.name: camera.rackFocus
props.doc: Blur in pixels on the grid and labels while the shot is tight; they snap sharp on the pull out.

props.name: camera.drift
props.doc: Handheld drift in pixels on the holds.
